typography_notes: All text is sans-serif. Title: very bold, ~28-30 pt, dark red (#C00000), centered, two lines, title case with irregular double spaces ('Neural  Network', 'vs  Convolutional'). Section labels ('Neural Network', 'Convolutional Neural Network') use a handwritten/comic-style font (Comic Sans MS-like), blue, ~14 pt, inside thin blue-bordered white boxes. 'Flatten (1-D)' is small bold italic red on a yellow highlight. 'FC' / 'O/P' / 'Conv' overlines are bold red sans ~13 pt. Block text is white sans ~10 pt rotated 90 degrees (reading bottom-to-top). 'Non Linearity' is bold blue ~11 pt stacked on two lines. Bottom caption 'Deep Learning (too Many Layers)' is bold italic red ~13 pt (note verbatim odd capitalization 'too Many'). No bullet lists, no numbered items, no equations.

Draw a thin red (#C00000) rectangle border from ~6% to ~94% width and ~7% to ~84% height; add a horizontal red rule across it at ~24% height to form a title band. 3. In the title band, center two lines in Verdana/Arial Bold ~28 pt, color #C00000: line 1 'Standard Neural  Network (NN) vs  Convolutional' and line 2 'Neural Network (ConvNet/CNN)' (preserve the double spaces). 4. NN row: place a white rounded rectangle with thin blue (#2222CC) border containing blue Comic Sans-style text 'Neural Network' at ~25% width, ~30% height. 5. Below it, insert a cat-meme photo (confused cat with white captions) at ~26-37% width, ~35-46% height. 6. Draw a short black right-arrow from the photo to a vertical stack of ~9 small circles colored green/red/blue/yellow repeating at ~42% width; above the stack place a yellow (#FFFF00) rectangle with red bold italic text on two lines: 'Flatten' / '(1-D)'. 7. Draw five orange 3-D rectangles (front #D4821E, darker side #9C5A12), each ~3% wide x ~13% tall, in a row from ~46% to ~74% width; add white ~10 pt vertical text 'Layer 1'...'Layer 5'; add red bold overlines 'FC','FC','FC','FC' above blocks 1-4 and 'O/P' above block 5; add a sixth orange block 'Loss' at ~76% width; connect blocks with tiny black arrows. 8. Add a red dash-dot horizontal line across the frame at ~49% height. 9. CNN row: add the blue-bordered box 'Convolutional Neural Network' at ~25% width, ~53% height. 10. Insert the Siamese-cat photo at far left (~14-21% width, ~59-76% height) and skew it into a parallelogram (Crop to Shape > Parallelogram or free rotate/skew). 11. Draw six orange 3-D parallelogram slabs (~6% wide x ~18% tall each) from ~24% to ~73% width with white vertical two-line labels: 'Conv. layer 1', 'ReLU layer 1', 'Max pool. 1', 'Conv. layer 2', 'ReLU layer 2', 'Max pool. 2'; add red bold 'Conv' above slabs 1 and 4; add blue bold two-line 'Non' / 'Linearity' below slabs 2 and 5. 12. To the right, add two upright orange rectangles with white vertical text 'Layer 5' (red 'FC' above) and 'Layer 6' (red 'O/P' above), then a final orange rectangle 'Loss'; connect all with small black arrows. 13. Below the frame, draw a long thin red right-pointing arrow from ~17% to ~87% width at ~85% height; center beneath it the bold italic red ~13 pt caption 'Deep Learning (too Many Layers)'. 14. Optionally add a small gray '+' at ~74% width, ~88% height, and a solid black rectangle strip across the bottom ~5% of the slide to replicate the video-frame look.
